notes_sections.heading: Keyword results
items: All four confirmed skill-chip IDs returned zero results this run, matching 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-21: DevOps Engineer (1338), Site Reliability Engineer (8473), Cloud Engineer / Cloud Engineering (10001), DevSecOps Engineer (6831).

Platform Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer still have no confirmed skill chip. Fell back to the unfiltered role=5,16 listing (1,394 total openings, sorted by recency) and title-skimmed the first page (~20 postings).

The unfiltered feed's relevance density remains very low — dominated by unrelated freelance gigs (LATAM Salesforce/CMS/QA/AI-annotation roles, CNC programming, iOS, storage admin, network/corp-IT hybrid roles) rather than infrastructure/DevOps work. Only the same 2 postings from the prior two runs were topically adjacent: the TaskRabbit role (Applied — carried forward from applications.md, score 4, below current filing bar on rate) and the same US-only DevOps Cloud Engineer posting (Skipped/Ineligible, carried forward — not reopened).

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Third consecutive run against this source with the same outcome — confirms 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-21 findings rather than surfacing anything new. Braintrust currently has almost no SRE/Platform/DevOps-specific demand for the target titles; worth deprioritizing this source's checking frequency relative to higher-yield boards until the skill-chip inventory turns over.
Browser-driven throughout, per the skill's requirement (client-side rendered, direct HTTP returns an empty shell).
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred; no account created, no profile submitted, no sign-in.

Checked applications.md fresh this run: TaskRabbit (https://app.usebraintrust.com/jobs/17859/) is Applied — 2026-09-19; United States Cold Storage is Skipped — 2026-09-21 (Ineligible, US-only). Both statuses carried forward, neither re-scored nor re-filed.
Zero new eligible postings this run — nothing qualified for automatic filing under the shared automatic-filing policy (no row scores 5+ and is current/eligible/unfiled).

method: Ran all four confirmed skill-chip searches (DevOps Engineer 1338, Site Reliability Engineer 8473, Cloud Engineer/Cloud Engineering 10001, DevSecOps Engineer 6831) as separate navigations per the skill's no-AND-combining rule, plus the unfiltered role=5,16 Engineering+IT feed as the required fallback for Platform Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer (no confirmed skill chip for either). All 6 mandatory queries complete — 4 zero-result, 2 (Platform/FDE fallback) reviewed via the same title-skim of the first ~20 unfiltered results. No blocking, CAPTCHA, or login wall encountered. Auto-filing: 0 new rows — the only 2 topically relevant postings already have applications.md rows (1 Applied, 1 Skipped/Ineligible), preserved as-is per policy.
